title: Сам себя и самостоятельно
description: Сам себя и самостоятельно: применяем правило в новых ситуациях, разбираем словарь, диалог и авторский текст без аудирования.
objectives: Отличать by myself от with myself
notes: She introduced herself: подлежащее и объект относятся к одному человеку.
By myself может означать «самостоятельно, без помощи»: I repaired it by myself.

quality.method: author-review + schema/grader/editorial-reference checks; no independent teacher review

exercises.prompt: Выбери точный вариант: The new volunteer introduced ___ to the group.
exercises.explanation: Возвратное herself указывает, что она представила саму себя.

exercises.prompt: Вставь слово из пары: myself / me.
exercises.editorial_answer: I completed the form by myself.
exercises.explanation: By myself означает без посторонней помощи.

exercises.prompt: Исправь ошибку в указанной конструкции, сохраняя остальные слова и смысл.

public_payload.sentence: She looked at himself in the mirror.

accepted: She looked at herself in the mirror.

exercises.reference_answer: She looked at herself in the mirror.
exercises.incorrect_answer: She looked at himself in the mirror.
exercises.editorial_answer: She looked at herself in the mirror.

public_payload.passage: At the first meeting, Maya introduced herself and explained that she was new to the area. Two volunteers showed her the booking system. A week later, she completed a booking by herself. She was pleased to work independently, but she still asked for help when a form contained an unfamiliar question. Working alone did not mean refusing all support.

options.label: The whole first meeting without volunteers.

exercises.explanation: A week later относится к самостоятельному оформлению брони.

exercises.prompt: Соедини слова с переводом в контексте урока.
exercises.editorial_answer: myself — себя, сам (об I); herself — себя, сама (об she); themselves — себя, сами (об they); independently — самостоятельно
exercises.explanation: В этих контекстах: myself — себя, сам (об I); herself — себя, сама (об she); themselves — себя, сами (об they); independently — самостоятельно.

exercises.prompt: Отказалась ли она от любой помощи?

public_payload.passage: At the first meeting, Maya introduced herself and explained that she was new to the area. Two volunteers showed her the booking system. A week later, she completed a booking by herself. She was pleased to work independently, but she still asked for help when a form contained an unfamiliar question. Working alone did not mean refusing all support.

options.label: No; she still asked about unfamiliar questions.
Yes; she would never ask anything again.
Yes; independently always means without any communication.

exercises.editorial_answer: No; she still asked about unfamiliar questions.
exercises.explanation: Последняя часть специально ограничивает смысл самостоятельности.

lines.speaker: Собеседник
lines.text: Did anyone help you fill in the form?

options.label: No, I filled it in by herself.
No, I filled it in by myself.
No, I filled it in by me.

exercises.editorial_answer: No, I filled it in by myself.

public_payload.sentence: Doing a task without needing someone to direct every step means working ___.

exercises.explanation: Independently описывает самостоятельность, не одинаковость или случайность.
